profile.name: Kvaser CAN总线接口适配器
profile.description: 这是一种用于将计算机连接到CAN总线网络的硬件接口设备，可用于发送和接收CAN报文、监测总线通信，以及在实验室中对基于CAN的控制器、仪器或嵌入式设备进行联调、测试与诊断。
profile.description_en: This is a hardware interface device that connects a computer to a CAN bus network. It is used to transmit and receive CAN messages, monitor bus traffic, and support laboratory integration, testing, and diagnostics of CAN-based controllers, instruments, and embedded systems.
